name: ers
description: Connect Cursor to eResource Scheduler. Manage resources, projects, bookings, timesheets, rates, and reports through the ERS MCP server with OAuth.

skill.name: ers-scheduling
skill.description: Plan and manage eResource Scheduler data via MCP — resources, projects, bookings, timesheets, rates, and reports. Use when the user asks about ERS, resource scheduling, capacity, utilization, allocations, or timesheet workflows.

workflows.goal: Book a resource on a project

rules: Minimum API hits: prefer native ERS one-shot operations (bulk edit, recurring patterns, booking split).
Pass filters to search/report tools; do not fetch-all and filter in the agent.
For creates, list types with `ers_type_get`, ask for required fields by display name, then create.
Admin configuration is read-only over MCP; tags can be searched/created only.
Pass `confirm=true` when a destructive tool requires it.
